checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both hands remain closed around small dumbbell handles through the arm lift.
checks.feet: Prone torso and legs remain stable. Upper arms extend laterally, elbows remain at 90 degrees and forearms point forward in an L shape while both arms lift.
checks.movement: Light dumbbell variation of prone L raise. Upper arms lateral at shoulder level, forearms point forward, elbows fixed 90 degrees. Lift arms a small distance while trunk and legs remain stable. 3.5 seconds lift, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
